findings.summary: spi net /LPS_SCK crosses VIN plane gap
findings.description: spi signal /LPS_SCK crosses a gap in VIN plane on layer B.Cu.
findings.recommendation: Re-route /LPS_SCK to avoid the VIN plane gap, or bridge with a stitching capacitor.

report_context.impact: Increased EMI from enlarged return path loop

findings.recommendation: Bridge the plane gap with copper pour or stitching vias. If zones were modified after the last fill, run KiCad Edit → Fill All Zones (B) and re-run the analyzer first — stale zone fills are a common cause of apparent plane splits.

findings.recommendation: Bridge the plane gap with copper pour or stitching vias. If zones were modified after the last fill, run KiCad Edit → Fill All Zones (B) and re-run the analyzer first — stale zone fills are a common cause of apparent plane splits.
